title: Geometric component counts commute with base change
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For $s\in S$, let $n_f(s)\in\mathbb N\cup\{\infty\}$ be the number of maximal nonempty connected subsets [def-weil-connected-scheme] of $X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}K$, where $K$ is any algebraically closed extension of the residue field $\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field] [def-weil-algebraic-closure]; an infinite number is recorded as $\infty$, and the empty fibre has count $0$. This number is independent of $K$. For every morphism $g:T\to S$, put $f_T:X\times_ST\to T$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then $n_{f_T}(t)=n_f(g(t))$ for every $t\in T$.
